commands.summary: starts a new interactive Claude Code session in DIR (default: the current directory) on the account PROFILE (default: the one the config rules pick), as a window of the tmux server this runs in, which the dashboard lists; detach (the default for a tool call) does not show or select the window, prints the new pane and where it is as session:index, and never opens a dialog, so when the rules say to ask which account it fails and names the profiles to pass

opens a tmux window in DIR that runs COMMAND, one string for the shell, and prints the new pane and where it is; the window closes when the command ends, and it lands in the session that owns DIR on the tmux server this runs in; detach (the default for a tool call) does not show or select the window
names an agent on the dashboard; K is its session id or pane id, and an empty NAME clears the name back to the window title
prints the tags of a session on one line, separated by spaces, or nothing when it has none; K is its session id or pane id

adds TAGS (words separated by spaces or commas, 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and . _ : / -, case ignored) to the tags of a session and prints the result; a session keeps at most 10, and the dashboard's search finds it by them; K is its session id or pane id
replaces the tags of a session with TAGS and prints the result; an empty TAGS clears them; K is its session id or pane id
prints which account profile the config rules pick for DIR (and the tmux SESSION, when given), or ask, without starting anything; prints nothing and exits 1 when no profiles are configured
prints the config as tagents reads it, one path and value per line, which includes the account profiles a session can be started on
prints what is wrong with the config, one line each, and exits 1 while anything is; prints nothing and exits 0 when it is sound
